data.title: Snowflake’s AI-Driven Growth Runway Underpins Buy Rating and Unchanged $460 Price Target
data.description:
Analyst William Power of Robert W. Baird maintained a Buy rating on Snowflake, retaining the price target of $460.00.

William Power has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors that highlight Snowflake’s strengthening competitive position and growth runway. He sees Snowflake as well aligned to benefit from enterprise AI adoption, with the CoCo platform already driving meaningful engagement and poised to support accelerating consumption trends over the coming quarters.

Power also notes that CoCo’s user base is still in the early stages of expansion across Snowflake’s thousands of enabled accounts, providing substantial upside as organizations broaden access beyond initial pilots. In addition, emerging initiatives like CoWork and continued momentum in cloud data modernization reinforce his view that Snowflake can extend its reach to more business personas and deepen its core data warehouse franchise, supporting his unchanged $460 price target and Buy recommendation.
